sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 2 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、META、MSFT、TSLA、SNDK。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • June nonfarm payrolls shockingly weak at 57K (expected around 115K), with May sharply revised down to 129K and April revised to 148K (a combined 74 thousand fewer over the two months). The unemployment rate nevertheless fell to 4.2%—but the decline was due to the labor force participation rate falling to 61.5% (the lowest since March 2021), not an improvement in employment. The community, as usual, interpreted this as “bad data = rate cuts = buy,” but intraday today there was already a split over whether “bad news is ultimately bad news.”
  • Second bloodbath in semiconductors/memory: The selloff triggered yesterday by Meta surging 11% (after announcing the sale of excess AI compute capacity) continued. As of 11:00 ET, SNDK -9.9% (1832), WDC -6.3% (561), MRVL -5.4%, NBIS -5.7%, AMD -3.9%, QCOM -2.4%, MU -3.9%, breaking below the 1000 level to 992, and NVDA -0.8% (196). The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index faced multi-leg selling pressure in succession.
  • Meta backlash: The original culprit META itself was -3.7% today (590). The community widely circulated claims that yesterday’s Bloomberg compute-capacity report was “seriously inaccurate and had its headline revised,” with anger directed at “Zuck destroyed the entire AI sector and then destroyed himself.”
  • Tesla Q2 deliveries of 480K “blowout” yet stock falls: Far above the 406K consensus, but the stock was -6.5% (398), breaking below 400—a classic sell-the-news move—combined with rumors of an FSD safety investigation. TSLA’s intraday RSI once fell into single digits.
  • Software/defensives supported the market against the trend: MSFT +1.5% (390), AAPL +4.4% (307, the strongest among Mag7, jokingly called the “orange man trade”), and AMZN +1.4% propped up the Dow, with DIA +0.86%; while QQQ was dragged down by semiconductors at -0.85%, and SPY +0.22% barely turned green, stuck below 750.
  • Crypto and meme names moved independently: MSTR +8.7%, COIN +5%, HOOD +6.3% (approaching a new high), RIVN +10.5% (guidance raised + short squeeze), PLTR +3.4%.
  • Holiday schedule: The market will be closed all day tomorrow, July 3 (July 4 falls on Saturday, so the holiday is observed on Friday); today is a regular full trading day, and the community rumor of “market closes at 1 today” is misinformation.

社区氛围：整体情绪很快从昨天的贪婪转变为困惑、焦虑和对“粗鲁”的怨恨。大多数人愤怒地抱怨“每天开盘假涨，10点抛售”的算法程序，以及“独立日必须上涨”交易的失败，同时仍然要么逢低买入半导体残骸，要么押注尾盘V形反弹。这是一种典型的高度波动的拉锯战状态，多头和空头都被杀死，没有人知道该怎么办。

恐惧/贪婪：从贪婪滑向局部恐慌，但尚未达到崩溃水平——SPY 仍呈绿色，VIX 仅在 15 左右，AAPL/MSFT 提供了下限。内存领域的恐慌最为严重。

情绪与现实的背离：社区对“降息是看涨”的乐观情绪显然与实际的市场行为（纳斯达克疲软、半导体崩盘、特斯拉暴跌）背道而驰。许多人错误地认为大盘已经“全绿”，而实际上道琼斯指数走强，而 SPY 基本持平——这是剧烈的板块轮动，而不是广泛的抛售。
